name: AdvancedMD EHR
one_liner: Cloud-based EHR with DSM-5 templates, AI ambient listening, and integrated billing starting at $130/month for mental health practices.
short_description: AdvancedMD is a comprehensive cloud-based practice management and EHR platform with purpose-built workflows for mental health and behavioral health practices, supporting DSM-5 charting,...
long_description: AdvancedMD is a cloud-based EHR and practice management platform designed for independent medical practices with dedicated support for mental health and behavioral health. The platform includes purpose-built workflows aligned to DSM-5 criteria, charting solutions supporting long-form clinical documentation, treatment planning, and progress notes. In October 2025, AdvancedMD launched AdvancedMD Now, a unified platform specifically for mental health practices with up to three providers, offering instant access with a free 30-day trial. An AI Clinical Assistant with ambient listening was released for desktop in early 2026 and mobile in June 2026. Key features include appointment scheduling, billing and claims management, patient intake with electronic signatures, SOAP notes, telemedicine, patient portals, and reporting analytics. AdvancedMD integrates with Eleos Health for enhanced behavioral health AI capabilities. The platform is considered ideal for multi-provider group practices with complex billing needs, though solo therapists may find SimplePractice or TherapyNotes more cost-effective.

pricing.notes: Setup fees range from free to $1,000 for smaller practices, up to $6,000 for complex enterprise migrations. Managed billing services priced at 3-7% of collections.

platforms.notes: Cloud-based with web, desktop, and mobile apps. AI assistant available on both desktop and mobile.

faqs.q: How much does AdvancedMD cost for mental health practices?
faqs.a: AdvancedMD mental health pricing starts at $130/month for small practices (up to 3 providers) with AdvancedMD Now. Larger group practices start at $399/month. The full bundle with EHR, practice management, and patient engagement is $729-999/provider/month.

faqs.q: Does AdvancedMD have mental health-specific features?
faqs.a: Yes, AdvancedMD includes purpose-built workflows for mental health aligned to DSM-5 criteria, long-form clinical documentation, treatment planning, progress notes, and severity disorder monitoring.

Yes, AdvancedMD released an AI Clinical Assistant with ambient listening in early 2026 for desktop and June 2026 for mobile. It also integrates with Eleos Health for enhanced behavioral health AI documentation.

faqs.q: Is AdvancedMD good for solo therapists?
faqs.a: AdvancedMD is best suited for multi-provider group practices with complex billing needs. Solo therapists and small practices may find SimplePractice or TherapyNotes more appropriate and cost-effective.
